name: Giant Biogene Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Giant Biogene Holding Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of bioactive material-based beauty and health products in the People's Republic of China. It offers functional skincare products, medical dressings and devices, and functional food products under the KOMFYMED, Collgene, Ke Yu, SKIGIN, and other brands. The company also develops and manufactures rare ginsenosides technology-based functional food products. In addition, it provides aesthetic services. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Xi'an, the People's Republic of China.
